notes.title: Various Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed bug where going back to the tutorial would cause grey boxes to appear on the object bar
Fixed colliders on Farmhouse
Fixed interactive colliders on Break Room
Fixed mesh issues on Construction House
Fixed lighting on Construction Site
Fixed bug with interactive objects not highlighting
Fixed bug with hint system not working sometimes

notes.title: Introducing: Screensaver Mode
notes.content:
Screensaver mode has been added to Out of Sight!

Screensaver mode hides the UI and enters into an automatic sequence that changes the level every 2 minutes. Now you can take in those uninterrupted views and listen to Purrple Cat's chill lofi playlist for the ultimate zen-like experience!

This update also includes some quality of life improvements:


Tilt-Shift / Depth of Field is off by default for new players. Existing players can still toggle Tilt-Shift off in the settings. Settings > General > Tilt Shift.
Reduced the excessive goal of 1000 spins required for the "Feeling Dizzy?" achievement. It's now 200.
Various collider fixes that prevented the player from clicking on an object at a certain angle.
Fixed an object clipping through the wall in "Break Room"
Increased brightness on "The Ranch", "Office" and "Night City"
Increased visibility though water for "City Park" and "Ocean"
Moved skateboard spawnpoint_1 ([spoiler] underwater location [/spoiler]) to a better location.
Increased zooming speed when using the scroll wheel
Added speed controls for movement and rotation. Settings > Controls > Rotation or Movement Speed
 Fixed "low, medium, high, very high" translations for Simplified Chinese.


Added more object spawn points on the following levels:


City Park
Pirate Island
Night City
Foreset River
Kitchen
Ocean


And on a personal note, thank you so much to everyone who has already purchased the game! Your support and feedback mean the world to me and I'm glad you're enjoying Out of Sight!
